_doc: engine/publish_check.py settings (T0.19). denylist: the approver's untracked list of terms that must never be published (one per line; whole word, any case; 'case: Term' for exact case). allowed_email_domains: email addresses are allowed only at these domains and their subdomains (example domains for tests, GitHub noreply, the co-author line). forbidden_dirs and forbidden_names: tracked paths that must never exist. The source folders' absolute paths come from config/protected-paths.local.json.
